published: source, protocol, calibration/proof, reports/plots, aggregate point/shard statistics, audit records, selected checkpoints, stage command/exit/stdout/stderr
retained_locally: per-frame test/validation npz, complete train_history.jsonl, non-selected checkpoints, large fault arrays, full original hash inventories, downloaded papers
verification_limit: Published summaries and checkpoints can be hashed and compared. Full independent per-frame audit requires the retained raw archive; completion_audit is historical evidence.
portability: Original immutable JSON/PT retain absolute host paths and source hash keys. Use checkpoint_repository_path for checkout-relative lookup; do not silently rewrite original artifacts.
